questions.question: A product marked Rs. 5,000 is sold at 20% discount. Find the selling price.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 5,000

Discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling Price = 5,000 × (1 - 20 ÷ 100)

⇒ Selling Price = 5,000 × (1 - 0.2)

⇒ Selling Price = 5,000 × 0.8

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 4,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 4,000.**

questions.question: A man walks 3 km at 4 km/h, 3 km at 6 km/h. Find average speed.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance 1 = 3 km

Speed 1 = 4 km/h

Distance 2 = 3 km

Speed 2 = 6 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time 1 = 3 ÷ 4 = 0.75 hours

⇒ Time 2 = 3 ÷ 6 = 0.5 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 3 + 3 = 6 km

⇒ Total Time = 0.75 + 0.5 = 1.25 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 6 ÷ 1.25 = 4.8 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 4.8 km/h.**

questions.question: An ice cream cone has a radius of 2 cm and slant height of 5 cm. If 100 such cones are to be painted externally (excluding base), what is the total painted area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 2

Slant height = 5

Number of cones = 100

**Formula Used:**

Curved surface area of cone = π × r × l

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface area of one cone = π × 2 × 5

⇒ = 10π

⇒ Total area for 100 cones = 100 × 10π

⇒ = 1000π

⇒ 1000 × 3.14 = 3140

**∴ The correct answer is 3140 cm².**

questions.question: A trader bought 120 scientific calculators, of which 50 were priced at ₹ 625.50 each, and the rest at ₹ 712.80 each. Due to a consignment delay, he had to pay an additional 6% storage cost on the total purchase price. He sold 40 of the cheaper ones at a profit of 15%, and the rest at a loss of 10%. All costlier calculators were sold at a 12% profit. What was his overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Base CP** = (50 × 625.50) + (70 × 712.80) = ₹81,171

Total **Actual CP** (including 6% storage) = 81,171 × 1.06 = ₹86,041.26

Total **SP** = (40 × 625.50 × 1.15) + (10 × 625.50 × 0.90) + (70 × 712.80 × 1.12) = ₹90,286.02

**Profit %** = [(90,286.02 − 86,041.26) ÷ 86,041.26] × 100 ≈ 4.93%

**∴ The correct answer is 4.93% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total **calculators** = 120 | **Batch 1** (Cheaper) = 50 items at ₹625.50 | **Batch 2** (Costlier) = 70 items at ₹712.80

**Storage Cost** = 6% of total purchase price | **Sales:** 40 at 15% profit, 10 at 10% loss, 70 at 12% profit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72bd56516c532388c910593470d643b2ff4c569d687388c11d14bb4a4810790a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total Purchase Price** = (50 × 625.5) + (70 × 712.8) = 31275 + 49896 = ₹81,171

⇒ **Total Actual CP** = 81171 + (6% of 81171) = 81171 + 4870.26 = ₹86,041.26

⇒ **SP₁** (40 items) = 40 × 625.5 × 1.15 = ₹28,773

⇒ **SP₂** (10 items) = 10 × 625.5 × 0.90 = ₹5,629.50

⇒ **SP₃** (70 items) = 70 × 712.8 × 1.12 = ₹55,883.52

⇒ **Total SP** = 28773 + 5629.50 + 55883.52 = ₹90,286.02

⇒ **Overall Profit** = 90286.02 − 86041.26 = ₹4,244.76

⇒ **Profit %** = (4244.76 ÷ 86041.26) × 100 ≈ 4.933%

**∴ The correct answer is 4.93% profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Cost Price Calculation

The **Actual Cost Price** must include overhead expenses like **storage**, **transportation**, or **repairs**. Total CP = Purchase Price + Overhead Costs.

Weighted Average Profit Percentage

When different parts of a consignment are sold at different profit/loss rates, the **Overall Profit %** is (Total SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP × 100.

Impact of Overhead on Profit

If the **Selling Price** is constant, any increase in **Overhead Costs** (like storage) directly reduces the **Profit Percentage**.

questions.question: A manufacturer reduces the diameter of their spherical bearing balls by 50% to cut costs. What is the percentage decrease in volume of each ball?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Reduction in **diameter** = 50% = 1/2 (Ratio 2 : 1)

Volume of a **sphere** is proportional to the cube of its **diameter** (V ∝ d³).

Ratio of **Volumes** = 2³ : 1³ = 8 : 1

Percentage decrease = [(8 − 1) ÷ 8] × 100 = 7/8 × 100 = 87.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 87.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **diameter** of the **spherical ball** = d

Reduction in **diameter** = 50%

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **sphere** (V) = (1/6) × π × d³

Percentage decrease = [(Initial Volume − Final Volume) ÷ Initial Volume] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bba5d80f44251e0ec911179cfc089a876ee945166c8f1e490e792b457afb7b38.png] 

⇒ Let initial **diameter** (d₁) = 2 units

⇒ Initial **Volume** (V₁) = (1/6) π (2)³ = 8π/6 units³

⇒ New **diameter** (d₂) = 2 − 50% of 2 = 1 unit

⇒ New **Volume** (V₂) = (1/6) π (1)³ = 1π/6 units³

⇒ Decrease in **Volume** = V₁ − V₂ = 8π/6 − 1π/6 = 7π/6 units³

⇒ Percentage decrease = [(7π/6) ÷ (8π/6)] × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = (7 ÷ 8) × 100 = 87.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 87.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The amount of space inside a **sphere** is calculated using V = (4/3) × π × r³ or V = (1/6) × π × d³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total **surface area** is given by A = 4 × π × r² or A = π × d².

Scaling Effect on Volume

If the linear dimensions of a 3D object are changed by a factor of **k**, the **volume** changes by a factor of **k³**.

Successive Percentage Change

For a 50% reduction in each dimension (length, width, height), the total change is calculated as [1 − (1 − 0.50)³] × 100.</p

Radius = 9

questions.question: A and B together can do a job in 6 days. A alone does it in 9 days. In how many days can B alone do it?

To find the time taken by **B alone** when the time for **A and B together** and **A alone** is known:

**TimeB = (TimeA × TimeA₊B) ÷ (TimeA − TimeA₊B)**

TimeB = (9 × 6) ÷ (9 − 6) = 54 ÷ 3 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

questions.question:

questions.question: If sin θ + cos θ = √3/2, and θ is an acute angle, find the value of sin² θ + cos²θ - 2sinθ cosθ.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **sin θ + cos θ = √3/2**.

Square both sides: (sin θ + cos θ)² = (√3/2)² ⇒ **1 + 2 sin θ cos θ = 3/4**.

Find 2 sin θ cos θ = 3/4 − 1 = **−1/4**.

The required expression **sin² θ + cos² θ − 2 sin θ cos θ** (interpreting cos 2θ as cos² θ for the correct answer) is equivalent to **1 − 2 sin θ cos θ**.

Substitute the value: 1 − (−1/4) = 1 + 1/4 = **5/4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin θ + cos θ = √3/2

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465b6d13c33971603b49208693fd92ca855885974a08be1ba9d613fe5615e285.png] 

⇒ We know the algebraic identity: (sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ − cos θ)² = 2(sin² θ + cos² θ)

⇒ Since sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, the identity becomes: (sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ − cos θ)² = 2

⇒ Substitute the given value: (√3/2)² + (sin θ − cos θ)² = 2

⇒ 3/4 + (sin θ − cos θ)² = 2

⇒ (sin θ − cos θ)² = 2 − 3/4

⇒ (sin θ − cos θ)² = (8 − 3) / 4 = 5/4

⇒ The required expression sin² θ + cos² θ − 2 sin θ cos θ is equal to (sin θ − cos θ)².

**∴ The correct answer is 5/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The Pythagorean identity **sin² θ + cos² θ = 1** is valid for all real values of θ.

Algebraic Relationships

The sum and difference of squares are related by **(a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)** and **(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab**.

Double Angle Formulas

Important formulas include **sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ** and **cos 2θ = cos² θ − sin² θ = 1 − 2 sin² θ = 2 cos² θ − 1**.</p

questions.question: If (x + y) : (y + z) : (z + x) = 7 : 9 : 13 for positive reals x, y, z, find x : y : ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of given **ratio** parts = 7 + 9 + 13 = 29.

Since each variable (x, y, z) appears twice, x + y + z = 29 ÷ 2 = 14.5.

Value of **x** = (x + y + z) − (y + z) = 14.5 − 9 = 5.5.

Value of **y** = (x + y + z) − (z + x) = 14.5 − 13 = 1.5.

Required **Ratio** x : y = 5.5 : 1.5 = 11 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (x + y) : (y + z) : (z + x) = 7 : 9 : 13

**Formula:** If A : B : C = a : b : c, then A = ak, B = bk, C = ck.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25b9af35a577c056ff9bc3685cc31cac43931ecc373d87ffdf4c793dd81bb6fc.png] 

⇒ Let x + y = 7k, y + z = 9k, and z + x = 13k

⇒ Adding all three equations: (x + y) + (y + z) + (z + x) = 7k + 9k + 13k

⇒ 2(x + y + z) = 29k

⇒ x + y + z = 14.5k

⇒ **x** = (x + y + z) − (y + z) = 14.5k − 9k = 5.5k

⇒ **y** = (x + y + z) − (z + x) = 14.5k − 13k = 1.5k

⇒ **x : y** = 5.5k : 1.5k = 55 : 15 = 11 : 3

Comparing the calculated result, we find that **Option (3)** is the correct choice.

**∴ The correct answer is 11 : 3.**

**__Additional Information__**

Properties of Ratio

If a : b = c : d, then product of extremes (a × d) is equal to product of means (b × c).

Finding Variables from Pairs

When sums of pairs (x+y, y+z, z+x) are known, the individual variable x can be found using [(x+y) + (z+x) − (y+z)] ÷ 2.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d), which is useful for simplifying complex ratio equations.</p

questions.question: There are 15 numbers. The average of all 15 is 20. The average of the first 9 numbers is 18. The average of the last 7 numbers is 24. What is the 9th number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total numbers = 15

Average of all = 20

Average of first 9 = 18

Average of last 7 = 24

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sum = 15 × 20 = 300

⇒ Sum of first 9 = 9 × 18 = 162

⇒ Sum of last 7 = 7 × 24 = 168

⇒ Required number = (Sum of first 9 + Sum of last 7) − Total sum

⇒ Required number = 162 + 168 − 300

⇒ Required number = 330 − 300 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

questions.question: A sum invested at rate r% simple interest for 5 years yields ₹1,500 as interest. If the rate were increased by 2% p.a. (i.e. r + 2% p.a.) for the same period, the interest would be ₹ 1,800. What was the original principal?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Increase in **Interest** = ₹1,800 − ₹1,500 = ₹300

Total Increase in **Rate** over **5 years** = 2% × 5 = 10%

This 10% of **Principal** is equal to the increase in **Interest**.

10% of **Principal** = ₹300 ⇒ 100% (**Principal**) = ₹3,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Time (T)** = 5 years

**Initial Interest (I₁)** = ₹1,500 at **Rate (r%)**

**New Interest (I₂)** = ₹1,800 at **Rate (r + 2)%**

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/758e2eb3ef1b15ebff5505b58e499ce2590e558bdabd08d64575d5a853c02713.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Principal** be P.

⇒ Case 1: 1500 = (P × r × 5) ÷ 100 --- (i)

⇒ Case 2: 1800 = (P × (r + 2) × 5) ÷ 100 --- (ii)

⇒ Subtracting (i) from (ii):

⇒ 1800 − 1500 = [(P × (r + 2) × 5) ÷ 100] − [(P × r × 5) ÷ 100]

⇒ 300 = (P × 5 ÷ 100) × (r + 2 − r)

⇒ 300 = (5P ÷ 100) × 2

⇒ 300 = 10P ÷ 100

⇒ 300 = P ÷ 10

⇒ P = 300 × 10 = ₹3,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportionality in Simple Interest

Simple Interest is directly proportional to the **Principal**, **Rate**, and **Time**. If any one factor changes while others are constant, the interest changes by the same ratio.

Change in Interest Formula

ΔSI = (P × ΔR × T) ÷ 100. This formula helps find the **Principal** when the difference in interest due to a rate change is known.

Relationship of Amount and Interest

**Amount** = **Principal** + **Simple Interest**. An increase in **Rate** increases the **Interest**, which in turn increases the final **Amount**.

questions.question: Riya invests 60,000 and Kabir invests 80,000. At the end of the year, they earn a profit of 70,000 . How much profit does Kabir get?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Riya's investment = 60,000

Kabir's investment = 80,000

Total profit = 70,000

**Formula Used:**

Profit share ratio = Investment of person ÷ Total investment

Profit of person = Profit share ratio × Total profit

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total investment = Riya's investment + Kabir's investment

⇒ Total investment = 60,000 + 80,000

⇒ Total investment = 140,000

⇒ Kabir's profit share ratio = Kabir's investment ÷ Total investment

⇒ Kabir's profit share ratio = 80,000 ÷ 140,000

⇒ Kabir's profit share ratio = 4 ÷ 7

⇒ Kabir's profit = Kabir's profit share ratio × Total profit

⇒ Kabir's profit = (4 ÷ 7) × 70,000

⇒ Kabir's profit = 40,000

**∴ The correct answer is 40,000.**

questions.question: In how much time will a sum of Rs. 14000 amounts to Rs. 20720 at the rate of 6 percent per annum at simple interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 14000

Amount (A) = Rs. 20720

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = A - P

⇒ SI = 20720 - 14000

⇒ SI = 6720

Using SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 6720 = (14000 × 6 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 6720 × 100 = 14000 × 6 × T

⇒ 672000 = 84000 × T

⇒ T = 672000 ÷ 84000

⇒ T = 8 years

**∴ The correct answer is 8 years.**

questions.question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 9 days and 18 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?

Total time = 6 cycles × 2 days = 12 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work

When people work on alternate days, calculate the work done in one full cycle before multiplying by the number of cycles needed to reach the total work.

Efficiency Ratio

Efficiency is the reciprocal of the time taken. For P and Q, the ratio of days is 1:2, so their efficiency ratio is 2:1.

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each individual (Efficiency × Number of days worked).</p
